name: SubmitMySaaS

sources.title: SubmitMySaaS pricing — Free vs $19 Premium weekly launches
Submit page — redirects to sign-in (Google, GitHub, email)

conditions: Only 10 free launch slots per week; free launches queue to an available Monday
The free tier's dofollow backlink is conditional: must finish Top 3 in the weekly ranking AND display the SubmitMySaaS badge
requirements: Account required — sign-in via Google, GitHub, or email/password
Weekly cohort launches every Monday at 8:00 AM UTC — all products scheduled for that week go live together
preparation: Product name, tagline, description, logo, category
Badge HTML for the free path, plus a plan to compete for Top 3 weekly votes if you want the dofollow link
workflow: Open /projects/submit and choose Free or Premium ($19/launch)
Pick an available Monday launch slot
Product goes live in the Monday 8:00 AM UTC cohort
On free: display the badge and rank Top 3 that week to earn the dofollow backlink
watchFor: Free dofollow is a ranking prize, not included by default — Top 3 weekly AND badge required
Premium ($19) skips the weekly slot cap, gets priority placement, and guarantees the dofollow link
Separate 'Sponsors' and 'Attribution Badges' pages — sponsorship is an additional paid surface
Submit page is a full auth wall — form fields not publicly visible
countsAsLive: The product appears on the weekly launch board (Monday 8AM UTC cohort) and in trending/categories with a detail page.
unknowns: How far out free Monday slots are booked
Whether non-Top-3 free listings retain any link (nofollow or none)
